instruction_text: Judge one candidate independently against the frozen Research Question and Topic boundary using only the exact Title and Abstract supplied. Return relevance 2 only when all four necessary dimensions directly match and AI/ML has a substantive task role; return 1 for a genuine but partial or auxiliary match; return 0 only for a directly evidenced hard mismatch; otherwise abstain. Do not rank candidates, select a Top-8, browse, retrieve full text, use another judgement, or provide private chain-of-thought.

relevance_definitions.0: At least one necessary dimension has a directly evidenced hard mismatch.
relevance_definitions.1: The work is in the target domain but is partial, auxiliary, or has a non-fatal boundary limitation.
relevance_definitions.2: All four necessary dimensions directly match and AI/ML has a substantive role in the target task.
relevance_definitions.abstain: Title and Abstract do not support a reliable judgement; relevance must be null.
